# Claritas Academics

> Claritas Academics is a premier Australian HSC tutoring service founded and run by 97–99+ ATAR high achievers. We provide personalised 1-on-1 online and in-person tutoring for Year 11 and Year 12 HSC students across New South Wales (NSW), covering Mathematics (Standard, Advanced, Extension 1, Extension 2), Sciences (Physics, Chemistry, Biology), English (Standard, Advanced), and Humanities (Legal Studies, Modern History, Ancient History, Business Studies, Software Engineering).

## About Claritas Academics

- **Tagline:** Clarity. Confidence. Results.
- **Mission:** Democratise elite HSC tutoring by offering top-tier tutors (97–99+ ATARs, State Rankers, Dux recipients) at accessible rates without corporate overhead, lock-in contracts, or hidden fees.
- **Teaching Philosophy:** Structured, results-driven 3-stage framework:
  1. *Clarity:* Deep first-principles conceptual understanding over rote memorisation.
  2. *Confidence:* Targeted exam strategy, active recall, and structured problem-solving.
  3. *Results:* Past paper mastery, marking criteria breakdown, and feedback.

## HSC Guides & Interactive Tools

- [How HSC Scaling Works: UAC Algorithm & 2025 Data Explained](https://claritasacademics.com/blog/hsc-scaling-explained.html): In-depth breakdown of UAC scaled marks, iterative simultaneous equations algorithm, 2025 Preliminary Scaling Report data analysis, myth busting, and an interactive 2025 subject scaling simulator.
- [How HSC Alignment Works: Raw Marks vs Exam Marks Explained](https://claritasacademics.com/blog/hsc-alignment-explained.html): Comprehensive guide explaining NESA HSC exam alignment, band descriptors, HSC Judges, and rawmarks.info historical data, including an interactive piecewise alignment simulator.
- [How HSC Moderation Works: Demystifying School Marks & Ranks](https://claritasacademics.com/blog/hsc-moderation-explained.html): Breakdown of NESA internal assessment moderation, rank matching, and final HSC mark calculation with an interactive Alice, Bob & Charlie model calculator.
- [5 Mistakes That Sink Ext 2 Related Rates Questions](https://claritasacademics.com/blog/ext2-related-rates-mistakes.html): Step-by-step mathematical guide on tackling related rates problems in HSC Mathematics Extension 2 without common setup traps.

## Pricing Plans

- **Foundation ($40/hr):** Group Classes, Technique driven teaching, Exam writing tips.
- **Excellence ($60/hr - Most Popular):** 1-on-1 online tutoring, Flexible scheduling, Greater Availability.
- **Premium ($70/hr):** 1-on-1 face-to-face tutoring, Impactful Feedback & Correction, At home or Library.
- **Free Trial Session:** Prospective students can book a free initial consultation and sample lesson with any tutor.
